5013.name: Drive Mode

values.11: Continuous 7 fps, 14 bit (order guess)

5013.evidence: PTP standard + M code book + USB list (9 values = manual's 9 options); 8 only in the Bracketing profile. Continuous speeds mapped by USB list order.

usb.note: Flip-verified in the third commit (the second commit had 1 and 5 swapped). PR #1370: D0E0 moves with it.

D138.name: AF frame size? (photo)
D138.evidence: Follows D137; 3 in LS / Pano, 4 Standard, 5 People/Animals (Q3 43: 5, LS 6). Manual: frame size adjustable in 3 steps. Dial & Dot calls it AF tracking sensitivity.

500B.name: Exposure Metering (photo)
500B.evidence: PTP + M code book + USB list in manual order; Highlight-Weighted in LS / Pano; factory Multi-Field = 2. The public USB label disagrees: Public: 2 = Center Weighted, 1 unlabelled. Draft: 1 = Center-Weighted, 2 = Multi-Field. The M firmware menu labels (1 Center-weighted, 2 Multi-field) and the factory value back the draft. The public label equals the generic PTP name for 2 ("Center Weighted Average") and the flip never produced value 1, so it looks carried over rather than observed. Draft probably right; one metering flip on a Q3 settles it.

usb.note: Public: 2 = Center Weighted, 1 unlabelled. Draft: 1 = Center-Weighted, 2 = Multi-Field. The M firmware menu labels (1 Center-weighted, 2 Multi-field) and the factory value back the draft. values.chars 10-14: five nibbles, all 1: one per Customize parameter? meaning of 1 unknown
values.chars 15-31: zero in every slot of both files

DA06.evidence: 16-byte record as 32 hex digits, same in all 7 profile slots. First word = Look ID in the same numbering as D69C/D69D. 11 slots = 5 pre-installed Core Looks + 6 slots for downloaded Looks (the 2023 Wi-Fi menu list had exactly six 'Leica Look 1-6' slots). Q3 holds 15, 12, 13, 16, 11, 21; Q3 43 holds 15, 12, 13, 16, 11 and an empty slot 6. Odd and even codes are identical twins; odd = photo, even = video is a guess (photo and video have separate Looks menus and selectors). Byte 4 = 100 in every slot including empty ones, so it is a default, probably Intensity (manual: 'Intensity can be set as a percentage'). The five 1-nibbles never vary, so the data cannot decode them.
